label: The Mexican president removed as Maduro was, and a God fearing government put in
description: A call for Claudia to be removed, that her day is coming just as Maduro day came, with a good God fearing government put in soon over Mexico for the Mexican people and great revival from the top down, alongside a prayer that Colombia government be exposed. Given in prayer form, but it names a sitting head of state and a comparison to an event that had just happened.
aliases: I call for Claudia to be removed
she will have her day and she will be removed just like Maduro
that you put a good government in soon over Mexico

label: Two Supreme Court justices step down
description: Two of the Supreme Court shall step down, given in passing alongside the Japan material and the fish sign. A retirement from that court is announced publicly, so a count of two either lands or does not.
aliases: the Supreme Court two shall step down
he said the two or whatever he said
